sentences.text:
Ganapat Dhondiba Madane Decd Thru Lhrs ... vs Competent
Authority , Land Acquisition ... on 16 March, 2023

Author: Gauri Godse
Bench: R. D. Dhanuka, Gauri Godse
 1/3 16-Wp-2976-
 rrpillai In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Writ Petition No. 2976 Of 2023
 Ganpat Dhondiba Madane Decd Thru Lhrs ...

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner
Machindra

Ganpat Madane
 vs.
Competent Authority, Land Acquistion and ...

Respondent
 Sub-Divisional Officer, Baramati and Ors.
 Ms. Manisha Devkar, Advocate for the Petitioner.

Mr. V. S. Gokhale, 'B' Panel Counsel for Respondent Nos
 9-State.

Coram : R. D. Dhanuka &
 Gauri Godse, Jj
Dated : 16 March, 2023 P.C. :-
1.

The short grievance of the Petitioner is that though specific objections were raised before the Competent Authority on 5th January 2021 and 25th January, 2021 annexed at pages 76 to 79 of the Petition, not to pay the compensation to anyone other than Shivaji Dagadu Madane and Ganpat Dhondiba Madane, the Competent Authority has not decided objections RAJESHWARI by RAJESHWARI RAMESH RAMESH PILLAI raised by the Petitioner in the impugned order.
Learned counsel for the Petitioner states that there is one more legal heir of the said Ganpat Dhondiba Madane and seeks leave to implead him as Petitioner No. 2.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Leave to amend is granted.
Amendment to be carried out within two weeks from today.

3. Learned AGP seeks time to take instructions as to whether any amount of compensation has been disbursed by the Competent Authority in favour of Respondent Nos. 2 to 8 or not and if not disbursed, would instruct the Competent Authority not to disburse the amount of compensation till next date.

Mr. Gokhale, 'B'
Panel counsel agrees to communicate to the Competent Authority not to disburse the compensation till next date.
It is ordered till next date, Competent Authority not to disburse the compensation to Respondent Nos. 2 to 8 or any other party.
4. Issue notice upon Respondent Nos. 2 to 8.

So far as Respondent Nos. 2 to 8 are concerned in addition to court notice, Petitioner is permitted to serve the Respondent Nos. 2 to 8 by private service, by all permissible modes of services available in law.
Affidavit in Reply by Respondent Nos. 2 to 8 shall be filed within two weeks from date of service of notice 3/3 16-WP-2976-2023.doc and copy to be served upon the Petitioners Advocate simultaneously.
5. Learned 'B' Panel counsel accepts service on behalf of Respondent Nos. 1 and 9.
Respondent Nos. 1 and 9 are permitted to file reply within two weeks from today.
Rejoinder shall also be filed within two weeks from service of date of reply with a copy to be served upon the Respondents Advocate simultaneously.
6. Learned counsel for the Petitioner agrees to communicate this order to Respondent Nos. 2 to 8.
For enabling information and compliance office to serve amended papers and proceedings upon Respondent Nos. 2 to 8.
Copy supplied to the Government pleader shall also be amended within three weeks.

7. Parties to act on an authenticated copy of this order.
8. Stand over to 20th April, 2023.
(GAURI GODSE, J.) (R. D. DHANUKA, J.)
